known_variances: PAD body once reads 'Permanently Applied Directives' vs. title 'Permanent Active Directives' — unfixable (immutable file); recorded here.

Case normalization differs between PAD ('Psychological', 'sixth law') and APD/ASC ('psychological', 'Sixth Law') — semantic content identical; strict law-extraction tooling (v4.0) will flag and must whitelist.
PAD/legacy name the 'ImpressionCore Governance Council'; APD names an unbranded 'Governance Council' — interpreted as the same authority under ADR-012.

ASC Article III describes PrismRefraction runtime enforcement (attestation, approval tokens, hash-chained ledger) not yet implemented in .nexus — bridge-level enforcement is this manifest + validator digest gate; full runtime enforcement is roadmap v4.0.
scope_interpretation: PRISM-scoped wording in the APD/ASC is interpreted per ADR-012 as governing all projects and participants coordinated through the Nexus Bridge, .nexus platform included.

verification.on_drift: FAIL (exit 1) — writes to the bridge should halt until the drift is investigated and either reverted or deliberately re-pinned by the Founder.
